summary.zh: 分阶段协作写完文档，再验证读者能否读懂
summary.en: Co-write documents in stages, then check reader clarity.

description.zh: 按结构化流程推进文档、提案、技术规格和决策记录的撰写，逐轮补充背景并打磨内容。适合篇幅较长、需要反复确认重点的写作任务，也适合写完先检验目标读者能否看懂。
description.en: Guides writing of documents, proposals, specs and decision records in a structured loop, filling gaps round by round. Suits longer pieces whose key points need confirming, and checks that the intended reader can follow.
